scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend

scripts.deploy: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push

node_modules.note: npm install is required in all three directories before any build or dev command will work

prerequisites_to_run.step_1: npm install (root) — installs concurrently, husky, lint-staged, vercel, chokidar
prerequisites_to_run.step_2: npm install (backend) — installs express, pg, cors, helmet, dotenv, zod, node-cron, @napi-rs/canvas, jest, nodemon
prerequisites_to_run.step_3: npm install (frontend) — installs preact, phaser, @tonconnect/sdk, @tonconnect/ui-react, @amplitude/analytics-browser, vite, @preact/preset-vite, rollup-plugin-visualizer
prerequisites_to_run.step_4: Create .env files in backend and frontend based on .env.example (or set env vars externally)
prerequisites_to_run.step_5: Backend requires PostgreSQL database (local via docker-compose.yml or external like Yandex Cloud)
prerequisites_to_run.step_6: Run backend migrations: npm run migrate (in backend dir)
prerequisites_to_run.step_7: Start dev servers: npm run dev (from root) or separately in backend/frontend

notes: Backend is ESM (type: module) and requires Node >= 20.0.0
Frontend is a Vite + Preact app; no separate dev server needed beyond Vite
Docker Compose for local dev includes PostgreSQL; production uses external DB (Yandex Cloud / Render)
Production frontend is hosted on Vercel; backend on Render or Yandex Cloud via Docker
Bot service exists in repo but is not mentioned in root package.json scripts
